title: The Other Side of Mall World
content: In all my 32 years of life I have never heard about this Conspiracy. I heard an Entire nine hour long iceberg about conspiracies (Wendigoon, 9 hours; you're a saint and a scholar) and barely heard anything about this. I researched and heard about dreams representing reality and emotions and feelings; but that's not what brought me to the Mall World conspiracy. What brought me here is one question that I feel others were hoping for as much as I dread this information. My question is simple: has anyone else seen the Ancient Ruins in Mall World? Has anyone ever tested the limitation of lucid dreaming and witnessed something that others have not?! Did anyone ever mention this and it not get pushed away as another late night snack binge gone wild?! I'll be brief (I tried, I'm sorry) with this Post and hope the right people can give me the clarity I request, but with this many mysteries; there is no guarantee I will. For context, please bare with me when I talk about my spiritual journey; it is the reason why you will be getting updates. Please forgive my Gamer knowledge or Crude terminology, I will be referencing video games and current movies because...I'm a nerd, sue me. Please forgive any unanswered question or real life implications due to this knowledge; I understand that lucid dreaming and/or Dreaming in general can be a very sensitive topic to people and offending and displacing belief is not my goal. All I'm doing is sharing some knowledge that isn't being spoken of or at the very least, give someone else a puzzle piece that could one day save our world. Any disbelief will actually be a comfort to my paranoia. I will start telling you two dreams; the first time I saw the ruins and the most recent time. The others are blips because of inexperience however these two are my most vivid. 1: Scene: The Mall World dream happened as normal; Had dinner with my friends. Saw random people, watched a whole wall warp into a zoo, the usual Mall World stuff however this dream shifted into something else after I witnessed a massive tsunami wash over everything in my dream. I can barely remember the Mall World dream because of how long ago it was but that wasn't the important part. This next part is though. [Underwater] I traveled downward as a group of five people with two submarines using their ship light to guide our way. At around 200 - 400 ft below surface level (where you can still see the sunlight through the waves) there is a large marble wall; it holds four pillars and looks like a Roman building however covered with algae, blue and green painted orbs and stains from the hues of the waters and fungus growing and underwater critters. On the left side of the wall, it looks as if it was a stone wall that has slid downward and been opened. We swam toward the door since the subs were too big to fit through the door. Once inside, there was what felt like an invisible barrier that turned us from swimming to walking in an instant. I don't even remember the gravity shift, one second we were surrounded from head to toe in water and the next second, no water, not even wet; just inside of a pre entry way. Inside there are more pillars that hold up the roof to this massive structure with stairs that lead downward into a rectangle formation, as if the stairs were placed together with an unworldly symmetrical positioning; a close representation (Minecraft for reference) is it was a 24 layer high rectangle hole where the stairs inside of it was going inward like a reverse pyramid, down to the center however the bottom looked more like a shallow stone pool rather than leading into a dark basement. The other side led to a different path. The wall held drawings and carvings (for referencing, it was as if I was staring at the Wall of Alduin from The constantly popular and reprinted game: The Elder Scrolls, Skyrim; specifically, the quest of the Blades Headquarters) as if a tale was told by being scribed on the wall. I walked up to the wall and saw a hallway that led into a tunnel-like structure with a very Other worldly appearance; it looked as if it was taken out of an ALIENS movie. As if I just walked into the experimentation cells of a mad scientist. I walked forward only to see these doorways or the right side that were made of a sleek metal and circle with a metal rim; as if they were sealed up rooms. I continued my path all the way down this curved hallway until I reached a room with a lever on the wall. The room was baron, not even a table or chair; just the oddly light blue color that was from the lights at the top of the room. I walked inside and approached the lever without hesitation. I don't remember why I did it, or what made me think I was safe but I pulled the lever and suddenly like a video game, it started a trap. Every one of the doors I passed opened up and within minutes, i let out these creatures from a different world. Imps adapted to the water and giant pale orges wielding guns, swords and shields. It was as if the Hell army from DOOM found a way into my dream. The moment I heard noises and saw them, I ran to the exit I came from. Dodging and sneaking through them all and not trying to be noticed amongst the weird creatures, but to them I was the odd one out. I got up from losing my balance from running and can barely see straight as I ran and ran and ran, and ran; I ran so much it felt like the hallway extended when I pulled the lever along with opening all the doors but...things didn't end well. The last thing I remember was being grabbed by a massive hand and then looking down into the jaws or a monster. With all my power and strength I forced myself awake. The intensity from everything had me questioning everything I felt but one thing for sure is that I had to be if that dream happened again. To ensure like my father raised me in real life, that in the dream world I will be just as prepared. For what?! I don't know and to be honest, I really don't care; it's better to be safe than sorry. Gracefully and like a message from God, that day came. 2: 11.14.2025 Most Recent Dream; Scene: [Mall World] This dream begins with the basic shared feelings of Mall World, the shifting from multiple different areas. Those who have experienced this occurrence know the feelings of memories or untold futures flashing while the shifting is occurring; Like reality distorting or travelling down a spiritual tunnel (Best reference would be Castlevania Season 2; The Infinite Corridor) showing different times, places and people. While shifting, I saw nice moments, humble moments, eventful moments; it showed me at dinner with my girlfriend, Arcade with my older brother when we were younger, looking at clothes and eating and staring at the usual Hot dog cart...I swear it's the most cursed thing there, not because of the hotdogs but because who puts a hotdog cart in-between two escalators?! I'm sorry, it stuck out too much during the dream to not mention it. Anyways, the last jump or dream shift I remember was being in the kitchen area of a school; from the feel of the area I felt as if it was on the bottom floor (1st floor) or downstairs of Mall World. That's when the usual unnatural occurrence begins; one second the mall is busy as can be and the next second; I walk out to see no one else in the mall. Just me and the silence of all the stores that have suddenly stopped shifting. Then it began, the same usual feeling; the feeling of being watched. I'm very spiritual in real life and have taken my spiritual journey to understand in my own terms to be on the sacred geometry level of the spiritual study. The best example I can give to a non believer is when taking LSD and begin seeing shapes; shapes are the fundamental form of the spiritual nature or spiritual world. Anyways, I looked up and immediately felt that the stares were coming from the top floor of Mall World even though I didn't see anyone or anything. I went up there and it looked like a school or classrooms (for me, it was one of the halls in ACHS). I entered the hall to feel multiple things but still no one was in sight. I didn't walk far before I saw something extremely weird (I'm sorry if this doesn't sound weird, I have never been in a classroom like this before). There was this one class room that had no one in it but still felt EXTREMELY off in its placing and design. It had four walls and all the walls had windows and blinds; as if the center class room was made to be looked into from the hallway for everyone; a display class if one exists. No white board or chalk board, no art equipment; a standard regular class room along with the unknown details. I walked in and looked around and saw chair desks in the center and weirdly, diner booth-like tables near the wall. I kept turning and inspecting the room until I turned and saw something in the corner of the room. I got closer and realized it was a person but I couldn't see their face; it felt like I was staring at the static on the tv just by looking at him. He wasn't looking at me, just staring forward. Suddenly, it felt like someone ran past the windows so I turned around and saw nothing but things started to get...WEIRD. Every time I looked at the windows, it looked as if the light was dimming or the blinds were being closed. I stared at the north wall, then looked back at the guy, he's the same. I looked at the west wall and saw it started to get dark but not pitch black. I quickly looked at the guy and he still looked the same. It wasn't until I looked at all 4 walls and watched the blinds creeped low to create an area of darkness in the corners of the room. The bottom light from outside was enough to light the room but still hold more dark than light. When the blinds were about 3/4 the way closed, I knew everything was going from bad to worse. I could see into the hallway; it looked normal as ever but it felt like something was staring inside the classroom; now looking through the narrow slit at the bottom of the blinds. I can't grasp why it felt this way but, it was the feel of eyes on me; I felt a lot of eyes, too many eyes but saw none. When that happened, I looked back at the guy to finally see it or rather understand what this disturb shifting feeling was. His skin was black, as if he was burnt from being trapped in a house fire and his eyes were small tiny orbs, white and piercing (Like the eyes of the Void in The Thunderbolts movie). His mouth was gritted angry, furious and growling; looking forward with a focus glare at the wall where the door used to be. I turned around to inspect the room one last time knowing in my heart that I must be dreaming. Horror movies are very overrated after having dreams like these; I don't need to have teenage girls screaming and tripping, I don't need one family to be cursed by a demon. That level of intensity is not entertaining to watch, put more so enlightening to the mercy that others are granted. Those who do not know are always the luckiest of us all. There wasn't any change to the environment at all. The same feeling of being stared at but from outside the room until, from behind me I can feel those piercing white eyes stare at me. Shift from its locked gaze at the wall, directly on to me. I felt those tiny little eyes stare and pierce my soul from behind me and in that moment, my soul reacted to what it felt. Like lighting a candle wick, I woke up but not from the dream but from reality. After seeing his eyes vividly, seeing his mouth show his teeth with creepy precision, my feelings of being watched while I'm dreamt, the feeling of horrible thoughts popping up in my head, the years of the doubt and fear of wasted time, it happened. I finally got what i wanted and needed to take the next step forward in my spiritual journey; to test out my spiritual knowledge. In that moment my brain went through my spiritual checklist for lucid dreaming; like activating a trap when your target creeps into position. I registered that I was witnessing an area I visited; Mall World and the infinite stores and rooms, the schools I grew up in, the people I met along the way. I acknowledged I've been here before, so I will remember this dream as I do now to a perfect recollection (One of the reasons I'm bringing this to reddit) and I had to archive or write this some way, and not just for myself; this knowledge is screaming to be known and hasn't left me since I had the dream. I registered everything, and I mean everything. The classroom in my dream was concrete as if nothing could break the walls, so no sudden interruptions and no more area shifting. Time has slowed down but it still feels normal as if I'm on a timer or stop watch but the timer just started. I'm not being pushed, or forced in any direction, I'm being guided by something; using my feet and moving through the dream. Like a genius figuring out the solution to an equation, I began to understand that at this point in time I COMPLETELY registered I was asleep, not only dreaming but lucid dreaming and in full control of myself. I thought I may never get this moment again. I may not dream again knowing that whatever this is, the full and true effects of this dream will be hidden and it may cost me more than I could believe but I was not in a mood to waste time or have regrets. I was in the mood that matched my energy, A Burning Rage with a spiritual flare. Using as much basic knowledge as I can (I can go in depth for any spiritual questions, feel free to ask) but in my journey, I have confirmed my spiritual element is Fire. It's one thing to have books that have been written by story tellers and manipulators, but what you feel in the spiritual world tells you more than any book can. When I meditate, I feel Heat in my body. When I close my eyes, I see the sun, when I manipulate energy, I see triangles; the sacred shape of fire. Fire is one with me as I am one with it. So when I started to channel my energy in my dream, the only thing that I felt was the flickering on my hands; the heat building in my fingers and the scorching rage growing in my eyes. I turn around at the guy sitting down in the corner of the room with my spiritual element coursing through my hands and arms like I practice everyday. " Fire, Fuego, Ignis, Freya, Sol ..." I chanted. I meditate on all the words of fire in every language I studied; I channelled fire from sacred geometry shapes that I have uncovered as I etched fire runes with my energy. On this night, not a single shred of knowledge that I have acquired wasn't used in that instant; that moment of vindication and purification, that day of mysteries and Answers. If you had the ability to ask God what tomorrow holds, would you not?! If you could find a fortune teller that was 100% accurate, would you not go?! If you had the opportunity to prove that all your time studying actually meant something, would you use it?! My questions were delivered with a black rigged smile and my emotions responded with the proper answer for what was in front of me; after all when faced against an adversary that has malice and hatred in their heart against you, what better fuel is there than anger?! I turned around with a fire burning in my eyes glaring at the guy in the chair looking forward. Staring at this monster that would wait until darkness rose for it to reveal its true face. Something that uses deceit and misfortune to bring me closer. I've had dreams where I got to speak to my father again, I had dreams where I spent the night under the stars cuddled up with my dream girl. To use these tactics, at this moment. To use those effects without any intervention, to resort to sending a message and you choose to do it like this only tells me what it really is. I lunge forward at him and clutch my hands around its throat. As I reached close in, I felt it bite my hand. I felt its sharp teeth pierce my skin, i saw like teeth vibrating with a sense of boiling anger, but I did not care. So many years of doubt freed my heart flooding it with confidence and clarity. So many questions answered if I was doing it right, sitting the right way or even talking to the right one. It was when my hands joined around its neck that I relished in this confrontation. So many days of pain and suffering that I have thought rushing through my head erupted in that moment my skin made contact with its burnt flesh. So many nightmares that have plagued me for all my life, It was finally receiving the punishment it deserved for what it did to me. I squeezed and I squeezed, even when I felt its jaws tighten and my hand tensed up; I squeezed. When his head started to shake and distort, I squeezed. At that moment, I registered the true feeling of control in lucid dreaming. I wasn't a scared boy who runs from danger, I was not the confused teen that was still growing, I was not the pre adult daring and making mistakes I can never take back; I was me as I sat and wrote this to you. "You Don't Belong Here!" I shouted in my dream as it roared sutley with its mouth clenched on my hand. When I was strangling the evil entity, the blinds barely moved and the darkness never flinched but i didn't think of anything other than getting rid of this creature. The fires around my hand began to burn brighter and brighter. Then suddenly, he vanished in my hands like a black cloud of smoke began swatted away. As he vanished the doors reappeared and my anger boiled even hotter. "Keep it going, Ignis de Sol, Freya, grant me strength." I ran out of the room, slamming the door against the wall and looking down the hall to see another figure. An old woman in white gown, with white hair and a look of focus as she is quickly seen at the end of a hall. She furiously floated fast from the right side of the hallway to the left side. I charged at her feeling an anger that I have been saving, the very same anger that people call a weapon. I ran to the end of the hall down that hall she went and that's when it happened again. The school changed from a hallway of classrooms and lockers into an Old Ancient Ruin. The first thing I saw, was the tan sand stoned stair case in the formation on an endless stair case, going down, and down, and down. Doors on each level and a hole like window on each wall with torches. Weird marking like the one in my previous dream but more structured more detailed, like staring at an alphabet compared to staring at a painting. I have had dreams where I have walked into the shadows and seen monsters come to claim my soul. I have seen dead relatives pass knowledge on to me from dreams. I have witnessed deja vu's that I thought couldn't possibly happen until it is that day, hour, minute on the second that I remember it happening before. When I stood at the top of those stairs, that's when I said: "You're leading me down there, aren't you?!" Then without a jump scare, without a grasp, without a sudden incident, I woke up. The dream ended and I was back in the real world. Getting ready for work and continuing everyday life in 2025. I couldn't believe anything I felt, heard, saw or endured, however I wish I could say it was a lie. I wish I could say I spent weeks typing up a short story for everyone to read, but it is not. If you get side tracked by everything I understand, you probably have way more questions and I will be happy to answer any of them, but I guess it's only fair for you to answer my question first: Did anyone else see the Old Ancient Ruins?
